name: catenary action
domain: 车辆轨道结构与数值方法
definition_zh: 大变形条件下构件通过轴向拉力形成的抗倒塌承载机制。
usage_overview: 用于分析局部构件失效后钢筋混凝土框架的大变形承载能力，关注梁板钢筋通过轴向受拉提供竖向抗力的阶段，以及钢筋连续性对这一抗倒塌机制的作用。

complete_examples.text: Under large deformations, the applied load was resisted by catenary action.
This model is able to reproduce the collapse resistance and deflection under CAA and catenary action stage with a good agreement.
Masonry infills can increase overall resis tance but have limited capacity at the catenary action stage.
This is because the catenary action exploits the strength of reinforcement to resist vertically gravity loads and reach much higher collapse resistance at the large deformation stage.
As observed in figure, the CAA and catenary action are correctly predicted.
As seen from the figure, the CAA and the catenary action are accurately described.
